headline: If adopted, H.Res. 517 would have condemned Rep. Darrell Issa's conduct at a 2014 committee hearing and required him to publicly apologize to the House.
what_it_does: The resolution would have condemned the manner in which Chairman Darrell E. Issa ran a March 5, 2014 House Oversight and Government Reform Committee hearing, calling it offensive and disrespectful. It would have required him to come to the well of the House and issue a public apology to Members. The House voted to table it or send it back to committee on March 13, 2014, so it was not adopted.
